ATO:ui:tagline: Non-destructive UV & texture atlas optimizer for VRChat avatars
ATO:ui:quality_tier:tooltip: Higher presets keep more detail and produce larger textures. 'Lossless' skips island rescaling entirely.
ATO:ui:generate_atlas:tooltip: When off, unused UV space is not removed and textures are only rescaled and re-encoded.
ATO:ui:msssim:tooltip: Islands whose short side is below 176 px fall back to single-scale SSIM; below 11 px this metric is ignored.
ATO:ui:padding:tooltip: Actual padding is ceil(atlas longest edge / 128), clamped up to this value.
ATO:ui:npot_help: NPOT atlases step in 64 px increments. Compression formats that require power-of-two dimensions are automatically excluded.
ATO:ui:mipmaps:tooltip: VRChat requires streaming mipmaps whenever mipmaps are enabled, so both are controlled by this single toggle.
ATO:ui:whitelist_help: Drop in any object: a GameObject, renderer, mesh, material, texture or animation clip. Every texture reachable from it is left completely untouched.
ATO:ui:err_no_descriptor: This component must be placed on a GameObject that also has a VRCAvatarDescriptor.
ATO:ui:err_multiple: Only one Avatar Texture Optimizer component is allowed per avatar. The build will fail until the extra components are removed.
ATO:report:title: Avatar Texture Optimizer
ATO:report:summary: Built {0} atlas(es) from {1} texture(s) ({2} skipped). Estimated VRAM {3} MB -> {4} MB ({5}% saved) in {6} s.
ATO:error:multiple_components: Multiple Avatar Texture Optimizer components found ({1})
ATO:error:multiple_components:descriptio: An avatar and its children may carry at most one Avatar Texture Optimizer component. Remove the extras and build again.
ATO:error:no_descriptor: Avatar Texture Optimizer is not on the avatar root
ATO:error:no_descriptor:description: The component must be attached to the GameObject that carries the VRCAvatarDescriptor.
ATO:warn:cancelled:description: Temporary assets already written to disk were kept; all CPU/GPU memory was released.
ATO:warn:texture_excluded:description: ATO could not prove that optimising this texture is safe, so it was treated exactly like a whitelisted texture.
ATO:warn:cross_seam_uv: UV{1} of '{0}' crosses a wrap seam
ATO:warn:cross_seam_uv:description: The island relies on repeat sampling across an integer UV boundary and cannot be repacked, so this UV stream was skipped.
ATO:warn:island_too_large: Texture '{0}' does not fit into any candidate atlas
ATO:warn:island_too_large:description: Its whole UV group was excluded from atlasing. The texture is still rescaled and re-encoded.
ATO:warn:format_platform_fallback: '{0}': {1} is not available on {3}, using {2} instead
ATO:warn:format_alpha_fallback: '{0}': {1} has no alpha channel but the texture needs one, using {2} instead
ATO:warn:format_channel_fallback: '{0}': {1} is single-channel but the texture uses {3} channels, using {2} instead
ATO:warn:format_unsupported: '{0}': {1} is not supported by this machine; the texture was left uncompressed
ATO:warn:crunch_npot: '{0}': crunch compression requires power-of-two sizes and was disabled
ATO:warn:aao_no_free_uv: '{0}': no free UV channel available for AAO evacuation
ATO:info:slots_merged: Merged {0} duplicate material slot(s) across {1} renderer(s)
ATO:info:slots_merged:description: Sub-meshes that ended up sharing the same material were combined, removing draw calls. Renderers whose slots are animated, or that carry a component addressing slots by index, were left untouched.
